english.note: Use 升 as the all-purpose choice when something physically moves upward or a price or level goes up.
Use this specifically when a rank, level, price, or position rises, rather than for physical climbing.

examples.english: I watched the water level rise by two marks.
examples.jyutping: go3 seoi2 wai2 sing1 zo2 loeng5 gaak3

examples.english: Housing prices may climb next month.
